headline: BNR will offer the market more "freedom" regarding exchange rate management
summary: The National Bank of Romania kept its reference rate at 6.5%, a level set in August 2024. Analysts expect it to stay there until mid-2027 as inflation has started rising again after falling to 6.17% in August.
why: The central bank sets Romania's benchmark interest rate and manages the leu. Its decisions affect borrowing costs, inflation expectations and currency values.
